book.name: 2 Tesalonaika
book.title: Tesalonaika Lenji Leta Theghewoniye Pol Le Rorori

content: Hu naŋgo kaiwame
Lama bodaboda, lama utu ghaghegovun ŋgoreiyake. Hu naŋgo kaiwame na mbala Giya utuniye i maya na i lawa, na gharɨgharɨ weinji lenji yavwatata weya Loi thɨ wo, na ŋgoranjiya ghemi.
Na tembe hu naŋgo weva Loi na i vamoruime weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ raraitharɨ moli, kaiwae ma gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye thɨ loŋweghathɨ.
Ko iyemaeŋge Giya i vakatha valaŋa budakaiya va le dagerawe, na iye ne i vavurɨghegheŋga na i garubuŋga thava lolo raitharɨ Seitan i vakowanaŋga.
Weime lama gharematuwo weya Giya kaiwami, na wo ghareghare emunjoru budakaiya va wo utugiya e ghemi mbe hu vakavakatha na mbe hu vakathambele vara.
Wo naŋgo weya Giya na iye i ndeviva e lemi renuwaŋa, mbala hu ghareghareya Loi le gharethovu na hu ghataŋaghathɨ ŋgoreiya Krais le ghataŋaghathɨ.
Raloŋweloŋweghathɨ mbala thiya kaiwovao

Lama bodaboda, Giya Jisas Krais e idae wo dage e ghemi, lemi valɨraloŋweloŋweghathɨna wolaghɨye iya mbema thɨ yaku bwagabwaga eŋge na vavagharena iyava wo vavagharena weŋga ma thɨ ghambu, thava hu wabwi na regha weimiyaŋgi.
Ghemi kaero hu ghareghare wagiyawe budakaiya va wo vakavakatha mbala mbe hu vakathava. Mbaŋa va wo yaku weŋga mava wo yakuyaku bwaga.
Ma ŋgoreiya vambema wo ghanɨghan bwaga eŋge lolo regha ele ŋgolo na ma wo vamodo. Iyemaeŋge gougou na ghararaghɨye wo rovurɨgheghe na wo kaiwo na thava wo vakatha ghamivuyowo regha.
Va wo vakatha ŋgoreiyako, gharerenuwaŋa ma ŋgoreiye ma valɨkaiwame woŋa na hu thalavuime, ko iyemaeŋge wo vakatha ŋgoreiyako na wo tabo lemi ghamba thuwathuwa.
Mbaŋa vamba iname ghena e tɨnemina, wo woveŋga mbaro na woŋa ŋgoreiyake: “Thela thoŋgo ma i kaiwo, ko thava i ghanɨŋga.”
Wo loŋwe utunimi, gharɨgharɨ vavana inanji e tɨnemina mbema thɨ yaku bwagabwagaeŋge, na ma nuwanjiya thɨ kaiwo. Ko iyemaeŋge mbema ghanjikaiwo eŋge thɨ mbaro lawalawa weŋgiya ghanjiune vavana.
Giya Jisas Krais e idae wo dage weŋgi na wo ŋaevairɨŋgi weinji lenji riwouda na thɨ kaiwo mbe thiye ghanjithalavu kaiwae.
Ko iyemaeŋge ghemi, lama bodaboda, thava weimi lemi riwobanebane thovuye ghavakatha kaiwae.
Thoŋgo ŋgoreiya lolo regha ina ghena ma i ghambugha mbaroke iya wo rori e letake iyake tɨne, hu ghareghare wagiyawe na thava hu tubwe na regha weimi, mbala i vakatha na i monjina.
Iyemaeŋge thava lemi vakatha regha i tharɨwe na ŋgoreiya iye ghamithɨghɨya. Ko iyemaeŋge ŋgoreiya ghaghami hu vathanavu.
Dage Mwaewo
Wo naŋgo weya Giya, iye gharemalɨlɨ gha Giya, iye ne i giya gharemalɨlɨ e ghemi mbaŋake wolaghɨye na e kamwathɨke wolaghɨye. Giya iye weimi taulaghɨna ghemi.

Mbaŋake mbe wombereghake vara e nɨmaŋgu ya roriya dagemwaewoke iyake. Letake wolaghɨye thiyake e tɨne ya roriya iyake na mbala hu ghareghare emunjoru Pol ghino ya rori. Nɨmaŋguke muiye mbe ŋgoreiyevara iyake.
Ya naŋgo ghanda Giya Jisas Krais le mwaewo i yaku taulaghɨna e ghemi.
